summary: Provisional joiner: cross-region device shipment, SCIM duplicate account, and timebound service-account request
description:
Issue summary:
We have a provisional joiner (internal candidate converting from contractor) who will start in two weeks. HR requests: 1) ship loaner MacBook from EU warehouse to APAC office; 2) create a timebound service account for initial onboarding CI tasks with scoped permissions; 3) ensure SCIM provisioning does not create duplicate SSO accounts during the conversion window.

Why this is tricky:
- The hire is cross-region: the provisioning workflow currently assumes device and SSO are in same region.
- We recently had a SCIM sync anomaly (see INT-135791) and want to avoid duplicate identities.
- KMS tagging and asset ownership must be set correctly to avoid compliance gaps when asset crosses regional inventory.

Requested outcome:
- Confirm a recommended step-by-step process and owner assignments for cross-region loaner device shipment and enrollment.
- Approve pattern and short-lived service account template (IAM policy) for onboarding tasks, plus expiry approach.
- Confirm SCIM sequence to convert contractor identity to employee without creating duplicates or account or group mismatches.
impact: Operational: onboarding timeline at risk for one hire; potential license duplication and asset tagging inconsistencies across EU->APAC; minor security risk if service account scope is too broad or expiry not enforced.
steps_to_reproduce: N/A - policy/process request (not a software bug). Provided for clarity: 1) Contractor exists in Okta/SCIM with contractor email alias. 2) Offer accepted for internal conversion. 3) HR triggers 'convert' flow which currently calls SCIM POST to /Users with employee attributes. Previously this led to duplicate accounts in 1/30 conversions.
investigation_notes: Checked recent SCIM error logs: no recent 500s, but two near-duplicate user records found in audit log for a different conversion on 2026-02-22 (okta-user-ids 24872 / 24873).
Confluence runbook 'scim-conversion-handbook' last updated 2025-11-03 — notes about using 'updateIfExists' flag but our HR tool sometimes omits it for internal conversions.

Asset inventory: eu-warehouse has MacBook loaner S/N XJ4392 tagged 'EU-LOANER-POOL'. Shipping to APAC requires asset transfer record and KMS tag update for 'region:ap-southeast' to ensure local encryption key handling policy is reflected.
Existing short-lived service account pattern lives in repo infra/onboarding/iam_templates but lacks an automated expiry enforcement; manual rotation required today.
Related ticket INT-135791 captured a SCIM desync root cause (stale user externalId mapping). Recommended to verify externalId mapping before create/update operations.
comments: 2026-03-10 10:12 - Miguel Ortega (HR Ops): HR needs clear owner for shipping and confirmation of ETA. Candidate must have laptop on day 1 local time.

2026-03-10 15:48 - Priya Desai (Platform Security): Recommended service account scope: limited to onboarding CI bucket read/write + timestamped tag. Must include automated expiry (30 days) and integration with secrets rotation. Draft IAM policy attached in comment (referenced).

2026-03-11 09:03 - Liam Chen (SRE): We can tag the asset before shipping and create an asset transfer event. For KMS, suggest creating a regional alias to avoid re-encrypting: kms:alias/redwood/ap-southeast/loaners. Will need asset-policies to approve cross-region key usage.

2026-03-11 11:20 - Aisha Patel (Reporter): Noted prior INT-135791; request to include a manual SCIM pre-check step in the runbook: verify externalId and attempt 'PATCH' to existing user before creating new user. HR tooling owner is @hr-automation (Slack).

2026-03-12 08:47 - Platform Security (comment): We'll prepare a hardened IAM JSON with expiry and require rotation via HashiCorp Vault lease. Security to own service-account template review; SRE to own enforcement hooks.
resolution: Pending — initial recommendations provided in comments. Next steps: security to publish templated IAM with expiry, SRE to add asset transfer + KMS alias workflow, and Identity team to add 'preflight SCIM check' to conversion flow. Owners assigned below.
follow_up_actions: Security: publish timebound IAM template by 2026-03-16
Identity: add SCIM preflight check to conversion flow and run in staging by 2026-03-18
SRE: create KMS alias and update asset-transfer playbook by 2026-03-17
HR: confirm shipping ETA and provide candidate local start date by 2026-03-13
